look_here_first: Look for a shrubby mallow with spear-shaped or hastate leaves and five pale pink petals marked with darker centers; inspect staminal column, calyx and epicalyx bracts.
photo_note: One licensed physical recognition photograph proposed for first-pass learner; botanical image anatomy and local BONAP status not completed.
identification_caution: South American species often grown or escaped in nonnative sites; Australian photo, not native Hays restoration recommendation.
